'''''White Panther''''' was the retrofitted [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] of the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Mab Kador]]. The [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] vehicle could be piloted with at least one individual onboard.<ref name="BF:H" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Kador took part with the ''White Panther'' in a [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] held at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The young [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], a fan of the sport, recognized both Kador and the ''White Panther'' before the race started. However, the winner of the race had been predetermined by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="BF:H" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''White Panther'' appeared in ''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'', a [[2003]] young reader novel by [[Elizabeth Hand]].<ref name="BF:H" />
